beats.narration_text: Liam, in for Bear — the last part of the Bear Brown logo. Composer summon, stroke pulse, scale breathe, and the exit family. Everything after the entrance and before the silence: how a mark idles, and how it leaves.

Your turn. Paste this: give my logo an idle state using a stroke dashoffset heartbeat and a one-percent scale breathe — then argue for which of the three exits in the family best suits an education brand. Idle states are the most forgotten tool in logo motion.
